courseGroups.title: Compulsory core
courseGroups.description: Big Data Management, Advanced Topics in Machine Learning, and Advanced Data Science Practice. All three are required.

courseGroups.title: Regression choice
courseGroups.description: Regression for Data Science or Advanced Regression Methodology.

courseGroups.title: Group 1: foundations & bridging
courseGroups.description: Your offer may allocate bridging courses here. Do not treat every listed course as required.

courseGroups.title: Group 2: statistics elective
courseGroups.description: Options include inference, Bayesian methods, multivariate analysis, data mining, forecasting and visualisation.

courseGroups.title: Group 3: computer science elective
courseGroups.description: Options include parallel computing, algorithms, enterprise computing, complexity and massive-data algorithms.

courseGroups.title: Group 4: wider electives
courseGroups.description: Choose with prerequisites, availability and the full 240-point total in mind. The catalogue lists the eligible courses.

courseGroups.title: Statistical computing
courseGroups.description: Statistical Computing Skills for Professional Data Scientists; the University guide places it in Semester Three.

courseGroups.title: Research project
courseGroups.description: A one-semester or two-semester research-project structure in the catalogue. The University guide says the project is full-time in the final semester.

stats: R basics, data frames and descriptive statistics
